items.html: And behold, the two lower ones of AA of Yetzirah are clothed in Aba and Ima, and one point of them — for it is three within three — from its three Sefirot remains revealed. And Atik of Yetzirah is the point of Malchut of Beriah, which descended here and was clothed in this third, revealed Sefira, as will be explained with God's help.
